add.issue.name: PERF-01: 8.4 points idle GPU above floor, unattributed

edit.description.md: Needs a QSG_RENDERER_DEBUG=change pass on the post-fix shell. StatusIcons.qml has no unconditional animation left.

add.issue.name: HW-AMD: AMD VRAM capacity detection never run on real hardware

edit.description.md: GpuVramSource sums /sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_vram_total, written to spec. The Omarchy VM is virtio only. Needs an AMD tester.

add.issue.name: AI-ROLE: Codex appears as a selectable chat provider when it's a harness

edit.description.md: Audit every AI chat surface against the harness/provider role field.

add.issue.name: PLUG-IDX: aphotic-plugins index has no CI, main is unprotected

edit.description.md: tools/build_index.py derives index.json from every plugin.toml (stopped the version-drift class of bug). Still missing: a job that regenerates index.json on push to main (a --check-only job would fail main the moment a version bump merges), plus branch protection — the treatment aphotic-themes already has.

add.issue.name: AgentEvents.hold() replays its backlog only to the first holder

edit.description.md: tail -n 400 is replayed only to the holder that starts it. The pet and notch tile both hold from shell start, so any later consumer joins mid-stream and sees an empty feed. A surface that needs history has to read the log itself. KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md wants this documented.

add.issue.name: wallust ANSI slots carry no guaranteed hue — semantic status colors drift

edit.description.md: m3error resolved to a muted purple, m3tertiary to pink, on a real install. Semantic status color can't come straight off the ANSI ramp — take saturation/lightness from the palette and fix the hue.

add.issue.name: A grep-shaped plugin test fails on its own explanatory comments

edit.description.md: Strip `//` before negative checks, same pattern tests/test_singleton_reachability.py already uses.

add.issue.name: Media notification audibility + site icons — needs a live check, then push + PR

edit.description.md: fix/media-notification-audibility, local only in a worktree. Built, suite green, Players instantiated windowlessly. Needs a live YouTube hover/playback check before pushing.

add.issue.name: Push the 3 owed wiki edits

edit.description.md: All drafted/unblocked in a scratchpad clone of aphotic-hypr.wiki: Agent-Graph.md's notch-tile + quota paragraphs (unblocked since #151/plugins#25 merged), a Commands tab paragraph (#152), and the pet's new settings rows paragraph (plugins #27).

add.issue.name: REL-02: Doctor

edit.description.md: aphotic doctor --json, --fix, an in-shell view with repair actions, export report. Safe Mode is where you send someone; Doctor is what you tell them to run. Pairs with the just-shipped status/diff/reconcile/rollback MVP.

add.issue.name: RES-02: Publish the Resource Engine design as prior art

edit.description.md: Small, can go in parallel with other work.

add.issue.name: RES-01: Resource Center UI

edit.description.md: A dashboard tab showing capacity, live claims, contentions, and priority controls. Makes the flagship visible to users who never trigger a negotiation.

add.issue.name: CMD-01: Universal Command Center

edit.description.md: Super+Space over applications, windows, workspaces, themes, plugins, profiles, agents, models, commands, system. Everything is an object with actions.

add.issue.name: ACT-02: The remaining ACT-01 consumers

edit.description.md: The substrate and two consumers shipped (notch palette, aphotic IPC). A launcher mode, a dashboard surface and the assistant are each a call to Actions.invoke() against the list that already exists, not another registry. CMD-01 builds on this.

add.issue.name: CLIP-01: Clipboard history

edit.description.md: Super+V, search, pinned, sensitive-value handling. Table stakes.

add.issue.name: CAP-01: Capture center

edit.description.md: Screenshot and recording, screen/window/region, FPS/audio/cursor options. Table stakes.

add.issue.name: SNAP-01: Config snapshots

edit.description.md: Aphotic-scoped, not filesystem-scoped: ~/.config/aphotic, ~/.config/hypr, plugin registry, themes, profiles, settings. Auto-snapshot before plugin install and theme change.

add.issue.name: IDLE-01: Split idle timings

edit.description.md: Separate screensaver and lock timeouts; dismissing the screensaver resets the lock countdown.

add.issue.name: BAR-01: Indicator cluster

edit.description.md: One glyph cluster mid-bar (DND, night light, recording, stay-awake), invisible when nothing is active, dimmed on hover. Low effort, good UX, independent of SCR-01.

add.issue.name: MISC-01: Hyprland performance options in Settings > System

edit.description.md: VRR, VFR, swallow, DPMS-on-input, disable manual-resize animation. Ship as toggles, default to the safe set.

add.issue.name: NOTCH-02: Quota/usage enrichment for every harness

edit.description.md: NOTCH-01's schema is already harness-neutral (agent-quota.json keyed by provider). Codex has an equivalent via codex app-server's account/rateLimits/read, but spawning it takes seconds so it needs a cached poll, not a per-turn hook. OpenCode has no known equivalent.

add.issue.name: NOTCH-03: New plugin — mini Agent Graph notch view

edit.description.md: A lightweight notch-tile rendering of Agent Graph's topology off the same event data, installable and enabled without the full dashboard Agent Graph plugin. Sibling, not a dependency.

add.issue.name: NOTCH-04: Dev notch tile, same enrichment pass as NOTCH-01

edit.description.md: dev-notch-tile shows project/phase/resource claims/drift today; what to add is open — pull from whatever the Dev domain row ships next.

add.issue.name: NOTCH-05: Keybinds notch tab

edit.description.md: The notch's third core tile, after Processes and Commands. Renders services/HyprKeybinds.qml — the same data Super+K's full-screen cheatsheet already shows, condensed for the notch. Not built this pass, not a plugin — core, like Processes.

add.issue.name: CHR-01: One chrome for every surface

edit.description.md: The notch's chrome (1px m3outlineVariant hairline over the depth gradient, radius, padding) exists once inside Notch.qml. Bar, dashboard, settings, quick chat and every popout each draw their own. Extract as a shared component and adopt everywhere.

add.issue.name: SET-01: Settings becomes one uniform surface

edit.description.md: Close the gap between sidebar and pane, take the notch's approach: one bounded surface with one chrome, not a rail plus a page. Depends on CHR-01 for the chrome, and touches PLUG-04's answer for plugin rows at scale.

add.issue.name: BAR-03: Popouts on every bar style

edit.description.md: Bar.qml has 14 popouts; MinimalBar.qml ships an empty checkPopout() stub and CapsuleBar.qml has only its own media surface. Every style needs the shared popout host and the same fluid open, not a per-style reinvention.

add.issue.name: WIN-02: Bar icon click cycles an app's windows

edit.description.md: Clicking an app icon with five windows open should walk them, wherever they live, rather than always taking the first. Blocked behind ISSUES.md's WIN-01 focus bug, which is now fixed (#164) — worth re-checking whether this is unblocked.

add.issue.name: PLUG-04: The Plugins pane does not scale

edit.description.md: Noticeably laggy with a real number of plugins installed, a second of blank on first open. Drop the static install pane, list installed/enabled plugins with a toggle each and a settings popout. Answers the general question: what happens to Settings when 30 plugins each contribute rows.

add.issue.name: PERF-02: Qt runtime performance pass

edit.description.md: Distinct from PERF-01 (idle GPU). This is startup and interaction: pane load time, Loader versus eager instantiation, ShaderEffectSource count, model rebuild churn on every ScriptModel in a bar. Measure before touching anything, per playbooks/perf-profiling.md.

add.issue.name: WALL-01: Live wallpaper

edit.description.md: Wallpaper Engine compatibility, or a lightweight own-rendered option (rain first). Has to arrive as a plugin with a real Resource Engine claim, so the Engine can reclaim it under contention.
